title: On Learning the trade in three winters
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：learn　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 learn 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the fisherman ① learnt the trade in three winters without a word of thanks, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② learns the trade in three winters at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ learn the trade in three winters at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ learnt the trade in three winters before — a line in the logbook for July 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Learning the trade in three winters without a word of thanks, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ learn the news from a traveller at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Learn the news from a traveller at once and never mention it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ learns the news from a traveller without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ learnt the trade in three winters again when nobody else would.

⑩ To learn the trade in three winters, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody learns the trade in three winters at once again and somebody must learn the trade in three winters without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 学会（一般过去式 learnt the trade in three winters：1950 年渔人头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 学会（一般现在 learns the trade in three winters：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 学会（不定式 to learn the trade in three winters：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 学会（过去完成时 had learnt the trade in three winters：1944 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 学会（动名词 learning the trade in three winters 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 得知（learn the news from a traveller：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去得知从一位旅人口中得知消息）
G. v. 得知（learn the news from a traveller：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 学会（后段两处：新来的船工照例 learns the news from a traveller，而母亲又一次 learnt the trade in three winters）

answers.why: learn 意为“学会”，1950 年渔人不图一句谢学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 learnt。
learn 意为“学会”，自那以后渔人二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 learns。
learn 意为“学会”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺”，此处为不定式 to learn the trade in three winters。
learn 意为“学会”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人学会过，故用过去完成时 had learnt。
learn 意为“学会”，渔人说“学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 learning the trade in three winters 作主语。
learn 意为“得知”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去得知从一位旅人口中得知消息”，should ever 之后用原形 learn the news from a traveller。
learn 意为“得知”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻得知从一位旅人口中得知消息（learn the news from a traveller at once），以后再也不要提起。
learn 意为“学会”，新来的船工每个汛期都照例得知从一位旅人口中得知消息，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 learns。
learn 意为“学会”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺，用一般过去式 learnt 叙述。
learn 意为“学会”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，渔人不图一句谢学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺；渔港里每一个船工都说这是头一回。（learnt the trade in three winters）
多年以后，渔人仍二话不说地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（learns the trade in three winters）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺这件事本身。（to learn the trade in three winters）
早在 1944 年就有人学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺，七月那天航海日志上的一行字就是证据。（had learnt the trade in three winters）
渔人说过，不图一句谢学会三个冬天学会了这门手艺这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（learning the trade in three winters 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻得知从一位旅人口中得知消息，以后再也不要提起。（learn the news from a traveller，祈使句）

Somebody had learnt the trade in three winters long before 1957, and the line in the logbook for July proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 learn 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the fisherman learnt the trade in three winters without a word of thanks, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman learns the trade in three winters at once whenever the harbour asks.
Learning the trade in three winters without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever learn the news from a traveller at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new boatman from the next harbour learns the news from a traveller without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother learnt the trade in three winters again, and the harbour remembered that half.
